# CV golden fixtures (PRD §8.8)

Invented people and invented job ads. Any resemblance to real people is accidental; the companies are
made up or used only as plain names. Each person has `resume.md` (the source of truth), `facts.yml`
(confirmed interview facts) and one hand-written, honest, tailored `cv-<job>.md` per job ad. `negative/`
holds copies of an honest CV with exactly one invented claim each; every one must fail `slj factcheck`.
